title: Benchmark Rover Strategies
story: Convoy phase two. Compare deterministic work counts before choosing a search strategy.
lesson: Count modeled operations instead of wall-clock time. A sparse BFS model touches V vertices and E edges; a repeated full scan costs V squared.
objective: For each [vertices, edges] return {'bfs': V+E, 'scan': V*V, 'winner': 'bfs'/'scan'/'tie'}. Inputs are nonnegative.
hint: Compute both counts and compare. These are stated workload models, not timing measurements.
